data.title: Speeding fine: €98.50 total, 1 point
data.summary: The Central Fines Office (Zentrale Bußgeldstelle Musterland) issued a fine notice dated 16 September 2025 for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 27 August 2025. The total is €98.50 and 1 point is entered in the driving aptitude register.
data.explanation: You are accused of speeding 23 km/h over the 70 km/h limit outside built-up areas. You may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record with the fines office. The app shows the deadline, which counts from the delivery date on the envelope. Without a timely objection the fine can be enforced. Payment of €98.50 is due within two weeks of the decision becoming final (Rechtskraft), meaning after the objection period ends without objection. If you are unsure whether to object, consider advice from a lawyer or traffic law specialist.
